messages.author: 18c624431dbfdf9f
messages.subject: issues with acast and dcast in reshape2
parts:
Hello! I'm working my way through the reshape2 documentation to make
sure I've got it down. I'm using the 64 bit version of R 2.11-1 on
osx. stringr(0.4) and plyr (1.2.1) are up to date. However, when I
try the sample code, I get the following error:

> #Air quality example
> names(airquality) <- tolower(names(airquality))
> aqm <- melt(airquality, id=c("month", "day"), na.rm=TRUE)
>
> acast(aqm, day ~ month ~ variable)
Error in function (splits, drop) : unused argument(s) (dots[[2]]
[[1]])

I've googled around and such and not yet found anything about this.
What's going on here, and is there a fix? Or have I just missed the
boat on something that hasn't propagated its way into CRAN yet?
